title: Documents please?
description: this resourcepack changes item model and icon of book to document goverment like. good for RP
body:
# Documents please?
Running a nation, managing a city, or enforcing the law on a roleplay server loses a bit of its immersion when your official decrees look like a magical spellbook from a fantasy game.

Documents please? is a resource pack completely overhauls the default Minecraft book model and user interface icons, replacing them with a sleek, modern, and official administrative aesthetic. It is designed specifically for political roleplay, modern city builds, or any player who wants their paperwork to actually look like paperwork.

Features
- Official Document Model: Replaces the standard book item with a clean, professional folder or official ledger design.

- Modernized UI Icons: Updates the book icon in chests, inventories, and crafting tables to match the new governmental look.

- Roleplay resourcepack: Perfect for server mayors, presidents, police forces, and judges who need to hand out official laws, fines, permits, or licenses.

Dependencies: No mods required.

How to Install
1. Download the zip file from the Versions tab.

2. Open Minecraft and go to Options, then Resource Packs.

3. Click Open Pack Folder and drop the downloaded zip file inside.

4. Select Documents from the in-game list, move it to the active column, and click Done.
